Html.При запуске Aero спрашивает у GitHu: At startup Aero asks GitHub for the latest version number. Nothing about you is sent.
Html.Aero читает профили Chrome, Edge, Я: Aero reads Chrome, Edge, Yandex Browser, Brave, Vivaldi and Opera profiles, and bookmarks and history from Firefox.
Html.Бесплатно через вашу облачную папку: Free, through your own cloud folder: OneDrive, Yandex Disk, Google Drive, Dropbox or Syncthing. Everything in it is encrypted with a passphrase only you know. Bookmarks sync on their own, passwords with a button and Windows Hello. The same folder and passphrase bring your passwords back on a new PC.
Html.Защитить входы на сайты Windows Hel: Protect site sign-ins with Windows Hello
Html.Cookies и так хранятся вне файла бр: Cookies are already kept out of the browser file info-stealers look for, under a key that only opens inside Aero. With Windows Hello, that key also needs your confirmation every time Aero starts.

Html.Меняет весь интерфейс: материал окн: Changes the whole interface: window material, button and address bar shapes, panes, menus, tabs and animations. Liquid Glass — acrylic and hairline borders, like the tray menu, Material 3 — tonal surfaces and round buttons, Fluent — Mica like Windows 11, OLED — pure black and compact, Sidebar — vertical tabs and the page as a card. Everything stays adjustable afterwards.

Html.Все cookies профиля: cookies.txt дл: All cookies of this profile: cookies.txt for yt-dlp, curl and extensions, or JSON for Cookie-Editor. The file signs anyone into your accounts, so Aero asks for Windows Hello first. Keep it private.
